name: flores_plus_central_asia_benchmark
description: An extension of the FLORES machine translation benchmark focused on Central Asian languages and related pairs; it measures MT quality for low- and mid-resource language pairs. The benchmark evaluates translation models on held-out test sets to assess cross-lingual generalization and robustness for languages underrepresented in mainstream MT benchmarks.
reputation: Built on the well-regarded FLORES lineage, it is valued for low-resource MT evaluation but has narrower adoption due to its language focus.
